Done. Implemented right-click drag to create selection box in Plan mode:

- **Right-click + drag** on empty canvas draws a dashed selection rectangle
- **Release** selects all tasks intersecting the box (highlighted with dashed border)
- **Click + drag** any selected task moves all selected tasks together
- **Click outside** clears selection

Changes in `plan.jsx`:
- Added `selBox` and `selectedKeys` state (lines 69-70)
- Added `boxDown` handler for right-click drag (lines 265-270)
- Updated `bgMove`/`bgUp` to handle selection box (lines 279-284, 311-322)
- Modified `startDrag` to drag all selected keys (line 258)
- Added selection box rendering (lines 531-532)
- Added `sel-multi` class to selected nodes (line 539)

Changes in `bridza.css`:
- Added `.sel-box` and `.plan-node.sel-multi` styles (lines 400-402)
